source_description_html:
HYPER RS is a one-piece motorcycle suit created for those with pure adrenaline running in their blood. Ideal for the track and the street, it is made from premium A+ cowhide and features DuoLayer Protection™ technology, providing the highest level of AAA protection. Advanced hook-and-loop adjustable back (level 2), elbow, shoulder, knee and hip (level 1) protectors will keep you feeling confident on every kilometre. Replaceable elbow and knee sliders and reinforcing panels made from a stretch-leather combination increase safety for intense riding. Extensive perforations on the chest, arms and thighs and SuperMESH fabric on the collar and H2O HYDRO-HUMP aerodynamic hump ensure optimal ventilation. Your comfort on the ride will be enhanced by numerous elastic panels, an ergonomic 3D design, a soft finish on the cuffs and a new type of lining.

HYPER RS guarantees a level AAA safety due to premium A+ cowhide leather, triple and double stitching and DuoLayer Protection™ technology, a double layer of leather in the shoulder, elbow, buttock, hip and knee areas. Also contributing to the highest level of safety are advanced Level 2 back, elbow and Level 1 shoulder, knee and hip protectors. The elbow, shoulder and knee protectors are adjustable with hook-and-loop fasteners for an easy fit. Replaceable elbow sliders and a set of knee sliders provide additional protection. Reinforcement panels and large synthetic synthetic sliders on the shoulders and knees increase safety, even during the most intense riding.

The HYPER RS is characterised by extensive spot perforations on the chest, shoulders and thighs for excellent ventilation without compromising safety. Advanced SuperMESH fabric on the collar and aerodynamic H2O HYDRO-HUMP further improves breathability, keeping your body at optimum temperature in any riding situation.

The HYPER RS is designed for comfort in the most extreme conditions. A large volume of elasticisation panels and an ergonomic 3D design, a soft finish on the cuffs and a new type of lining that does not pull down when worn, increase comfort to the maximum. Elastic panels at the elbows, calves and buttocks, a widened leg with adjustable width, guarantee a perfect fit, even during the most dynamic manoeuvres.

Designed with sport riding in mind, the HYPER RS features the H2O HYDRO-HUMP aerodynamic hump, which you can equip with the H20 HYDRO-BAG, purchased separately. It will keep you properly hydrated during long rides. Available in four dynamic colour versions: black with red, black with white, fluo and blue, the HYPER RS combines the highest safety standards. It is a motorcycle suit ideal for track and street riding for those who love sporty style.

SHIMA Rush are versatile 2-layer textile pants. Designed for city and suburban trips, these motorcycle pants are highly effective for a variety of weather conditions. The removable, waterproof NextDry™ membrane will protect you from cold and rain. Long ventilation panels with zips on the thighs and at the bottom of the legs provide excellent airflow on summer days. In order to give good protection, Rush comes with breathable Level 1 knee protectors. In addition, it can still be retrofitted with a hip protector (sold separately). Reinforcement fabric on the knees and the back enhances the durability and tear resistance. Thanks to the leg width adjustments, Rush adapts perfectly to the body. Reflective panels give you a lot of confidence while riding. You can pair your pants with the matching SHIMA Rush jacket and gloves to create a stylish set.

source_description_html:
The SHIMA Bandit is an urban motorcycle jacket for adrenaline-loving men who love to move around the city jungle. Protectors for your shoulders and elbows as well as the ArmorPlus back protector guarantee the highest quality of safety and comfort while riding. The jacket is also equipped with large, TPU external shoulder sliders and detailed with double reinforced safety seams. The protection can be even more extended by an optional SAS-TEC Protector. The H3 Heat Free System and ventilation panels on your chest and forearms will provide comfort during summer days. This jacket features the EvoLink system for attaching accessory inner layers such as a cooling or heating vest (available as an option). The regular fit and the adjustable width in the hips area provide pleasant wearing comfort. Built with elastic breathable fabric inserts on the side, sleeves and back offer a dynamic fit while in riding position. Strategically placed reflective panels make you more visible during night rides. Bandit is made of high quality, soft cow hide and equipped with two types of connecting zippers: a 360° zipper as well as a short zipper, which allow a quick pairing with selected SHIMA pants.
